annotations.title: Attach a dataset to an ad set

description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Attaches a Meta dataset (pixel) to an existing ad set, optionally with the conversion event (e.g. PURCHASE). Pass agentName and reason. Audited in Ads > Agent activity. It cannot be undone from there: to change it back, call this tool again with the earlier settings.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/ad-sets/{id}/dataset.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

customEventType.description: Meta standard event, e.g. PURCHASE, LEAD.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

name: ads_ad_set_dataset
title: Attach a dataset to an ad set
